package.description: Git CLI wrapper with real-time activity tracking dashboard

en-US.description: Git CLI wrapper with real-time activity tracking dashboard
en-US.longDescription:
TGit is a Git CLI wrapper that tracks your development activity and sends it to a 
real-time dashboard. It supports tenant isolation for team/company privacy.

Features:
- Wraps all git commands transparently
- Tracks commits, pushes, status checks, and more
- Real-time dashboard showing developer activity
- Tenant isolation for multi-company environments
- Azure Cosmos DB backend for scalability
en-US.name: TGit
